args.title: Fix handling of trailing blank lines in CSV export
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Update the writeCsv function to properly handle trailing blank lines in the input data, preventing the 'Malformed row' error for CSV files that end with an empty line.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue arises because the CSV export does not handle trailing blank lines properly, causing a 'Malformed row' error for files that end with an empty line.
